scope.intended_use: Mark reading progress in an adult-owned book with an original stylised frog ornament and a parametrically controlled page clip.
scope.user_context: Adult dry-indoor reading; repeated manual insertion and removal from variable paper stocks.
variants: one 75 x 45 x 30 mm maximum launch size

interfaces.name: CAD-owned bookmark blade to book page

evidence.uncertainty_note: Paper thickness, coating, acceptable preload, permanent set and cycle life are unmeasured. The research value 0.8 mm is not accepted as a qualified blade thickness.

failure_modes.mode: Blade marks or tears a page
failure_modes.mitigation: Use rounded CAD edges and qualify preload on declared paper coupons.

failure_modes.mode: Blade takes a permanent set or breaks
failure_modes.effect: Bookmark loses retention or leaves a loose fragment
failure_modes.mitigation: Keep thickness parametric and require a 100-cycle physical test.

acceptance_criteria: Holds on declared paper samples without visible marking.
Completes 100 insertion cycles without fracture or permanent loss of retention.

blocking_unknowns: paper sample set and thickness range

criticality.rationale: Failure is expected to cause limited property damage or product loss, but a sharp or broken clip can damage a book or scratch a hand.

decision.rationale: Proceed with own reference generation and the organic frog preform. Keep every page-contacting dimension in CAD and block manufacture/release until the physical clip coupon passes.

warnings.message: The owned geometry-only Step1X fork is technically cleared only for new post-cutoff runs; image-generator rights remain a product-local warning.
Blade thickness, preload, paper interaction and cycle life have no physical evidence.

next_actions.action: Generate and archive an own transparent frog reference and a post-cutoff geometry-only Step1X run.
next_actions.exit_criterion: Prompt, input hash, runtime provenance and raw GLB are product-local.

next_actions.action: Design a CAD-owned blade coupon with named thickness and preload parameters.
next_actions.exit_criterion: Coupon source and dimensional audit exist without claiming a qualified fit.
Declared paper samples pass the acceptance criteria.
